text:
Ana (People Ops): Heads-up — the ATS webhook bulk import from last night looks like it dropped timezone and scorecard mappings for a batch of interviewers. Admin shows a bunch with timezone='TBD' and no scorecard attached. Anyone else seeing this?
ats-sync-bot: Import job 98765 completed with 17 errors and 42 warnings. Logs: https://internal-logs/redwood/ats/98765 (errors: mapping mismatch).
Miles: yep seeing it in the UI. CSV preview in the importer shows the timezone column shifted right for ~30 rows.
Ingrid: can you paste a tiny sample of the CSV?
Ana (People Ops): sure — here's the header + two rows (redacted):
```
email,first,last,timezone,interviewer_type,scorecard_id,preferred_location
jane@example.com,Jane,Doe,,onsite,SC-123,us-west
liam@example.com,Liam,Ng,UTC-08,onsite,,us-east
```
Samir: interesting — looks like some rows have an extra `preferred_location` column introduced by the new export, but the importer mapping still expects the old schema. delimiter looks fine (commas).
Jess: we rolled a change last week that added `preferred_location` to the export. I thought the webhook transformer included a backwards-compatible mapping but maybe not for scorecard_id.
Taylor (Eng): can you confirm job id? I can run a dry-run backfill after we patch the transformer. Don’t want to double-import.
Ana (People Ops): job 98765 is the one. please don't run until we confirm.
Taylor (Eng): OK. quick patch plan: 1) add mapping in webhook transform: map `scorecard_id` OR `default_scorecard` -> internal `scorecard_id`, and accept optional `preferred_location` and shift if missing. 2) run `./scripts/ats_backfill --job 98765 --dry-run` to validate. If dry-run OK, run without `--dry-run`.
Miles: also noticed many rows where `scorecard_id` is blank because the export used the old key `default_scorecard`.
Samir: quick workaround in transformer: if `scorecard_id` empty and `default_scorecard` present, copy value. I'll open a tiny PR.
Jess: can we carve out 30m to triage now? I can update the interviewer training docs afterwards so the export team is looped in.
Taylor (Eng): I can be there. propose 10:30am in #calendar — who else?
Ingrid: I can do 10:30.
Ana (People Ops): I'll be on the call. @Samir please drop the PR link.
Samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/ats-transformer/pull/711 — includes mapping and a unit test for the shifted column case.
nats-sync-bot: Backfill dry-run queued: task 22211 (user: Taylor). Expect ~2m to finish.
Taylor (Eng): dry-run finished — 98765 dry-run reported 0 destructive changes, 29 rows needing manual review (mostly missing email normalization), 41 rows fixed by mapping.
Ana (People Ops): great. next steps: Samir to merge PR, Taylor to run backfill at low-traffic window (2am PDT), Jess to update training doc and notify export owners.
Jess: will update training doc sections: "export schema changes" + a short checklist for ops to run before new exporter releases.
Miles: can we add a small automated schema check to the webhook that rejects unknown fields with a warning? would prevent silent shifts.
Taylor (Eng): good idea — I'll add a light validation step in the transformer to warn about unexpected headers and post a short report to #eng-platform.
Ana (People Ops): thanks all — filing a quick postmortem note and tagging hiring teams affected. :thumbsup:
Jess: can someone add the affected candidate/interviewer IDs to the thread so we can follow up? I'll handle comms after backfill.
Ana (People Ops): will compile a list after Taylor's run and drop it here.
Miles: thanks — and huge thanks to the quick fix. :)
